limitations: Homogeneous MySQL/PostgreSQL use separate UUID namespaces and separate production pools on the same local server, not separate machines.
Incremental synchronization means key comparison; it is not binlog/WAL CDC and does not delete target-only rows.
All data checks call the actual Rust synchronization engine; this suite does not assert GUI click paths.
